content.title: Online interview hai?
content.subtitle: Kuch universities shortlist ke baad baat karti hain. Ready raho.

steps.title: Camera aur light
steps.detail: Chehra saaf dikhe, light saamne se aaye. Background simple rakho.
steps.tip: Ek din pehle dost ke saath test call karo.

steps.title: Internet ka backup
steps.detail: Wi-Fi ke saath phone hotspot ready rakho. Laptop charge pe lagao.

steps.title: University ki research
steps.detail: Course, faculty aur projects ke baare mein padh ke jao. Kyun yahi, ye clear ho.

steps.title: Apna SOP yaad rakho
steps.detail: Jo SOP mein likha hai, wahi baat apne shabdon mein bolo. Ratta mat maaro.

steps.title: Apne sawaal ready
steps.detail: Aakhir mein poochne ke liye kuch achhe sawaal likh ke rakho.
steps.tip: Sawaal poochna dikhata hai ki aap serious ho.

caption:
Online interview hai? Ye 5 tayyari pehle se kar lo 👇

1. Camera aur light
2. Internet ka backup
3. University ki research
4. Apna SOP yaad rakho
5. Apne sawaal ready

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jiska interview aane wala hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
